sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000142-P1, was presented by BAVARIAN NORDIC (the Supplier) to Maple Grove Regional Hospital 142 on November 3, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 2.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 10 Other doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
